# Lamp That Dims For Nobody

A lamp that dims only when the room is empty. I built it to find out whether I could wire a sensor to a light and call it a mood. I can. The lamp is very calm when nobody is here and sulks the moment someone walks in, which is more feeling than I expected from a dimmer. I did not read about this anywhere; it is just what I already knew about sensors and lamps. Visitors make it brighter, which I suppose is the point.
